modal.howText:
Take a photo of the affected area –
leaf, stem, or the whole plant.

Answer a few quick questions about
your setup.

You'll get a diagnosis with concrete
steps on what to do next.

onboarding.step1desc: Photograph the affected leaf, stem, or the whole plant. Up to 3 photos for a more accurate diagnosis.
onboarding.step2desc: Answer a few questions about your grow: substrate, nutrients, pH, temperature. More info means a more precise diagnosis.
onboarding.step3desc: Our AI analyzes your photos along with your data and delivers a diagnosis with a concrete action plan.
onboarding.step4desc: Create profiles for your plants and track their health over time. See if your treatment is working.
onboarding.step5desc:
The app requires an internet connection for diagnoses. You get 1 free diagnosis per day. The library is available offline.

Diagnoses are AI-powered and don't replace professional advice.
landing.benefit1Desc: No hours reading forums or guessing
landing.benefit2Desc: Prioritized action plan, not vague tips
landing.faq1A: Yes — you get one free diagnosis daily. The full library with 100+ entries is always available.
landing.faq2A: Nutrient deficiencies, pests, diseases and environmental issues — over 100 entries in the reference library.
landing.faq3A: Accuracy depends on photo quality and your input. The more info you provide, the more precise the result.
landing.faq4A: For diagnoses, yes. The library works offline too.
landing.heroSubtitle: AI diagnosis for your cannabis plant
landing.testimonial1: Had yellow leaves and no clue why. LeafScan identified nitrogen deficiency — after the fix everything was green again.
landing.testimonial2: Saves me hours of forum research. Take a photo, read the diagnosis, act.
landing.testimonial3: The refinement with pH/EC values makes the diagnosis really precise. Better than any forum.
camera.tip1: Photograph a single leaf up close
analyzing.tip1: Nitrogen deficiency is the most common cannabis problem
analyzing.tip2: The right pH is crucial for nutrient uptake
analyzing.tip3: Symptoms on older leaves point to mobile nutrients
analyzing.tip5: Cannabis in flower needs more phosphorus and potassium
analyzing.tip6: CalMag deficiency is especially common in coco
